title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which faith honours the Bodhi tree most because of the Buddha? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Islam

2. What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. To ask for food
   B. To ask for rain
   C. To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   D. To ask for money

3. Which element is called Akash? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Space
   C. Water
   D. Earth

4. What does vidya mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Friend
   B. Wealth
   C. Father
   D. Knowledge

5. What does the Sanskrit word Panch mean in Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Seven
   C. Ten
   D. Five

6. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Body
   B. Fire
   C. Soul
   D. Water

7. Which festival in the lesson is celebrated near the middle of the year on 1 June? (1 mark)
   A. Maha Shivratri
   B. Yoga Day
   C. Paryushan
   D. Madaraka Day

8. In Kapaal Bhaati, which part of the breath is quick? (1 mark)
   A. Neither
   B. The breath out
   C. The breath in
   D. Both are held

9. What did the Buddha say about a person's words? (1 mark)
   A. They should be loud
   B. They should be false
   C. They should be rude
   D. They should be true, kind and helpful

10. What does vaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. Day of the week
   B. Year
   C. Month
   D. Planet

11. What did King Shibi offer to save the dove? (1 mark)
   A. His horse
   B. His own flesh, weight for weight
   C. His shoes
   D. His crown

12. What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for? (1 mark)
   A. Rain
   B. Money
   C. A big house
   D. Wisdom

13. Which is a mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Using a chart
   B. Learning the table
   C. Making a song
   D. Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar

14. What does the white colour of Saraswati stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Hunger
   B. Heat
   C. Purity and peace
   D. Anger

15. Shukra is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Mercury
   C. Venus
   D. Saturn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three signs of integrity at school. (3 marks)

17. What is an asana? (2 marks)

18. Describe what Prince Siddhartha did when a swan was hurt. (3 marks)

19. Give three benefits of yoga. (3 marks)

20. What do the words Param and atma mean? (2 marks)

21. Why is Saraswati shown with a veena and a book? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Buddhism
   The Buddha became enlightened under a Bodhi tree.

2. C — To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   It asks for a clear mind.

3. B — Space
   Akash is the open sky or space that holds everything.

4. D — Knowledge
   Vidya is knowledge.

5. D — Five
   Panch means five, and there are five great elements.

6. C — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

7. D — Madaraka Day
   1 June is mid-year.

8. B — The breath out
   The breath is pushed out in short pulls.

9. D — They should be true, kind and helpful
   Right speech.

10. A — Day of the week
   Vaar means day.

11. B — His own flesh, weight for weight
   He offered himself.

12. D — Wisdom
   It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

13. D — Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   Guruvaar is Jupiter and Shukravaar is Venus.

14. C — Purity and peace
   White is a sign of purity.

15. C — Venus
   Shukra is Venus.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Not cheating, owning up to mistakes, handing in lost items, telling the truth, doing your own work (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: A body posture.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for posture or seat.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: He pulled out the arrow, nursed the swan and, when it was well, let it go free. He said that saving a life matters more than taking it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for nursing, arrow, letting go free.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the body flexible and strong, helps us breathe well and stay calm, helps us focus and teaches discipline (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Param means highest and atma means soul.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The veena stands for music and the arts and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
